jei.impactsvitality.info.air_bladder: Use it in good air to fill it, then in thin air to get back 4 bubbles. 3 uses per fill.
jei.impactsvitality.info.air_compressor: Use a tank on it, then any furnace fuel: it fills the tank in 5 seconds, even in thin air.
jei.impactsvitality.info.air_tank: Carried anywhere (or on your back) with a Respirator on, it supplies air in thin air. It refills in good air.
jei.impactsvitality.info.bottled_air: Use a glass bottle in good air to bottle it. Breathe it in for 5 bubbles.
jei.impactsvitality.info.charcoal_filter: Fits a Respirator or Rebreather (in a crafting grid) and the Water Filter. Smoke and filtering wear it down.
jei.impactsvitality.info.cloth_mask: Use it on water to dampen it: a damp mask halves smoke for 2 minutes.
jei.impactsvitality.info.containers: Use a container on water to fill it, use it to drink one drink, and sneak-use it to pour one over yourself and cool off. Put water bottles in a crafting grid with it to pour them in. Mixing waters makes it as bad as the worst.
jei.impactsvitality.info.copper_still: With a heat source under it, purifies water from buckets and bottles, a bucket a minute. Hoppers feed it water and glass bottles from above and take the purified water from below.
jei.impactsvitality.info.hydration_pack: Wear it on your back (or in the chest slot) and press the Sip key to drink without holding it.
jei.impactsvitality.info.insulated_flask: Keeps Cold Water cold. Pour bowls of soup into it in a crafting grid to keep them warm.
jei.impactsvitality.info.linings: Sew a lining into any armor at an anvil (with Impact's Realistic Crafting, in a crafting grid with Twine and the Bone Needle): 3 wool for warmth, 4 rabbit hide for more warmth, or 3 leather to stay cool. The armor keeps its enchantments and damage.
jei.impactsvitality.info.netherite_rebre: Smoke never affects you, and it needs no filter.
jei.impactsvitality.info.rain_barrel: Collects a drink of clean water for every minute of rain falling on it, up to 16.
jei.impactsvitality.info.respirator: With a Charcoal Filter fitted, smoky air counts as good air. Wearing it lets an Air Tank supply you.
jei.impactsvitality.info.sipping: With an empty hand, sneak-use water to take a sip: 1 thirst of unclean water.
jei.impactsvitality.info.straw_hat: Shade: in the sun it widens the hot side of your comfortable range.
jei.impactsvitality.info.thermometer: Carry it anywhere in your inventory to see the temperature under the gauge.
jei.impactsvitality.info.tidebound_cante: Fills itself with purified water, faster in rain or water.
jei.impactsvitality.info.water: Every bottle of water picks up its purity when it's filled. Water from oceans and beaches is salty; water anywhere else is unclean, unless it comes from a boiling pot. Smelt, smoke or campfire any water bottle to purify it.
jei.impactsvitality.info.water_filter: Pour in unclean or salt water and put a Charcoal Filter in it: it drips out purified water. Sneak-use with an empty hand to take the filter out.
jei.impactsvitality.info.wooden_cup: Set a filled Wooden Cup on a campfire to purify its water.
